name: Sign Out
summary: An authenticated user chooses Sign Out, the current client session is terminated, local authentication state is cleared, and the client returns to the Welcome surface.

preconditions.expression: the user has an active authenticated client session

serverInteraction.intent: Terminate only the current client session, revoking the current refresh token for token-backed clients or ending the application cookie session for cookie-backed clients.

postconditions.expression: the current client is anonymous, its local authentication state is cleared, and protected application state is no longer available through the terminated session

sourceReferences.note: Existing web logoff terminates the ASP.NET Identity session and records UserLogout.
Existing mobile sign-out clears local auth state and navigates to login, but currently does not revoke the server refresh token.
Sign Out is one atomic user action. No dedicated confirmation or completion AuthView is required; the action is host-owned and the canonical destination is auth.welcome.
